overview_description.description:
Noon is a technology company with a simple mission: to be the best place to buy and sell things. In doing this, Noon hopes to accelerate the digital economy of the Middle East, empowering regional talent and businesses to meet the full range of consumers' online needs.

Starting in 2017 with noon.com, the region’s homegrown e-commerce platform and leading online shopping destination, noon is now a digital ecosystem of products and services - noon, noon Daily, noon food, NowNow, SIVVI, noon VIP, noon payments, and noon pay.

product.name: noon Online Marketplace
product.description: An e-commerce marketplace for purchasing products across electronics, fashion, home, beauty, baby, toys, groceries, automotive, health, sports, stationery, and books.

product.name: noon Shopping App
product.description: A mobile shopping application that provides access to noon’s product catalog, account management, ordering, delivery tracking, wishlists, and shopping offers.

product.name: noon Grocery
product.description: An online grocery service for ordering pantry goods, beverages, fresh food, household supplies, cleaning products, and other daily essentials for home delivery.

product.name: Electronics and Technology Products
product.description: A marketplace category covering mobile phones, tablets, laptops, accessories, audio equipment, wearables, cameras, televisions, gaming devices, and digital cards.

product.name: Fashion and Apparel Products
product.description: A marketplace category offering women’s, men’s, and children’s clothing, footwear, sportswear, bags, luggage, watches, eyewear, jewelry, and related accessories.

product.name: Home, Kitchen and Appliance Products
product.description: A marketplace category for kitchenware, furniture, home decor, bedding, bathroom supplies, tools, cleaning products, storage, lighting, and small and large appliances.
